revenueSources.source: Local Property Tax for Municipal Purposes
revenueSources.description: Portion paid on quarterly property tax bills by Town of Morristown property owners
Annual service charges from commercial & apartment PILOT agreements in Town of Morristown
Direct state formula aid distributed by NJ Department of Community Affairs

revenueSources.source: Local Fees, Permits, Municipal Court & Surplus
revenueSources.description: Construction UCC code permits, court fines, health licenses, and fund balance reserves

majorAppropriations.category: Town of Morristown Police Department & Dispatch
majorAppropriations.details: Salaries for sworn police officers, patrol division, detectives, 911 dispatch, and vehicles.
Medical, prescription, and dental coverage for active and retired municipal employees.

majorAppropriations.category: Department of Public Works (Streets, Sanitation & Parks)
majorAppropriations.details: Road resurfacing, snow plowing, garbage/recycling collection, and township park maintenance.
Mandatory employer pension billings from the State of New Jersey.
Principal and interest payments on capital improvement and infrastructure bonds.
Mayor, Council, Township Clerk, CFO, Tax Assessor, and legal defense counsel.
Public library operations, senior citizen services, and municipal recreation.

keyOfficials.chiefFinancialOfficer: Martin J. Kane Jr. (Chief Financial Officer)
